entities.name: landscaping
entities.description: The practice of modifying the visible features of an area of land, including planting trees, shrubs, and other vegetation to enhance aesthetic appeal and environmental quality.

entities.name: parking signs
entities.description: Signs used to regulate, warn, or guide drivers and pedestrians in parking areas, including 'No Parking' signs and parking permit signs.

entities.name: residential parking permit program
entities.description: A program that issues permits to residents allowing them to park in designated areas, often marked with specific signs and poles, to manage parking congestion.

entities.name: sign pollution
entities.description: The visual clutter and negative aesthetic impact caused by excessive or poorly designed signage in a community.

entities.name: parking issues
entities.description: Problems related to parking availability, signage, enforcement, and community concerns about parking regulations.

entities.name: swale
entities.description: A shallow, vegetated depression designed to manage stormwater runoff, improve water quality, and promote groundwater recharge.
